description: Steps through the hopalong attractor, a pair of equations that jump about without repeating, and puts out its x value

params.text: Sets the x value the attractor is put back to at reset, 0 to 1
Sets the y value the attractor is put back to at reset, 0 to 1
Sets the a term of the equations, 0 to 1; a is what the new y value is measured down from
Sets the b term, 0 to 1; b multiplies x inside the square root
Sets the c term, 0 to 1; c is taken off that product before the root
Runs the attractor on by this many seconds of steps before the reset values are taken, 0 to 100 seconds, so a reset can land far into the sequence

inputs.text: Each trigger here takes the attractor one step further
A trigger here puts the attractor back to the values set by SX and SY

outputs.text: The x value of the attractor as a voltage, held until the next clock

notes: with nothing patched into CLK the attractor is stepped every sample, which puts out an audio signal with its constant offset removed
the reset values are worked out afresh whenever SX, SY or Ofs is turned, but the attractor only jumps to them at the next reset

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
